source.title: An Exceptionally Simple Theory of Everything
source.author: A. Garrett Lisi
source.visual_source_check: Direct PDF page image reading of pp10/11, compared independently with source §2.2.1 bivector definition on printed p9.

fermion_and_gauge_roles.left: W in su(2)_L acts on LEFT-chiral fermion doublets only; upper 2x2 chiral block in electroweak Cl(4) representation.
fermion_and_gauge_roles.right: B_1 in su(2)_R is a DIFFERENT Pati-Salam right-chiral partner; lower 2x2 block, not a standard model SU2_L gauge field.
fermion_and_gauge_roles.right_cartan_u1: B_1^3*(i/2)*sigma3 lies in source u(1)_R; combines with source B2 of strong su3 complement in later Y relation.
fermion_and_gauge_roles.Higgs: phiPlus,phiZero complex Higgs doublet built from four real phi^mu as separately source-conserved at SSC0.21; source treats so(4) action on this as sensible proposal.
fermion_and_gauge_roles.source_algebra: so(4)=su(2)_L+su(2)_R=Cl^2(4), an asserted Lie algebra decomposition; do not promote full group equality or entire physical dynamics.
fermion_and_gauge_roles.source_cross_requirement: B1plus and B1minus are Pati-Salam extra right-chiral gauge bosons, not observed SM fields; possible heavy masses/left-right symmetry breaking are speculative source statements, not proven.

wew.source_bivector_definition: gammaPrime_{mu nu}=(1/2)*(gammaPrime_mu*gammaPrime_nu-gammaPrime_nu*gammaPrime_mu), as in preceding §2.2.1; source field w_ew^{mu nu} antisymmetric with ordered index roles.
wew.binder: tau ranges 1..3, summed; W,B1,V,U are real independent source Lie gauge coefficients only subject to displayed equalities, not four duplicate SI handles
wew.source_rotation: U,V are ANALOGOUS to 1/2 omega_T, omega_S gravity roles and relate to W/B1 by same pi/4 rotation plus scaling as gravitational Eq.(2.9); do not equate electroweak U with gravitational omega_T or import its factor of i.
wew.source_row_col: each displayed block is 2x2 complex; upper rows/cols 1,2 are left Weyl-doublet, lower rows/cols 3,4 right Weyl-doublet. No upper/lower interchange.

diagnostic_six_bivector_basis.declaration: This provides an exact 4x4 matrix witness. It is not a source assertion fixing all antisymmetric w_ew^{mu nu} index coefficient conventions or removing the explicit 1/2 Einstein-summation ambiguity.

cartan.source_assumptions: Cartan representative selects tau=3 independently in W and B1, not a full general connection/gauge-fixing theorem.

phiZero_weight_example.role: source Higgs phiZero has W3=-1/2, B1^3=+1/2, not equal to four-real phi^1 or another field label; source Lie bracket is a matrix commutator.

table4.exact_source_scope: All 16 printed ordered rows and 80 weight entries, not complete matter generation/mass/normalization theory.
table4.source_modality: Table 4 ASSIGNS proposed field/gauge weights and SM labels; agreement with known charges is claimed conditionally on identification. Do not infer existence or masses of B1plus/B1minus.
table4.distinguish_phiOne: phiOne (printed phi_1) is the complex source label -phi^3+i phi^4, NOT real phi^1; Table 4 phiOne row W3=+1/2,B1^3=-1/2.

derived_source_claims.coupling: author source implies g1=sqrt(3/5) and sin²(theta_W)=3/8; reported normalized source inference, NOT independently qualified physical phenomenology.
derived_source_claims.other_charge: X is source-mentioned B1^3/B2 orthogonal-partner quantum number, explicit numerical normalization not reconstructed here.
derived_source_claims.PatiSalam_nonstandard_bosons: The source explicitly says B1plus/B1minus are absent from Standard Model and presumably heavy or otherwise hidden. This is conjectural language; no mass theorem.

excluded_domains: DO NOT use source W and B1 as one SI gauge field.
DO NOT treat W/B1 coefficient domain as unrestricted complex in anti-Hermitian su(2); a complex coefficient is an out-of-scope negative test.
DO NOT identify old gravitational omega_S/T with current electroweak U/V; source states analogy and analogous rotation only.
DO NOT infer independent antisymmetric w_ew coefficient factor solely from diagnostic gamma-bivector witness; the source's 1/2 Einstein-index convention is explicit.
DO NOT treat the 2007 so(4) Lie algebra decomposition as real group isomorphism or SM electroweak breaking proof.
DO NOT import any Woit or cross-track source semantics, hypotheses or criticisms into L track.
DO NOT source-correct L05 octonion printed sign or real Spin(3,1) group equality based on this distinct finite L01 case.
pending: Source non-coordinate 1-forms for W and B1 and full grading/DTS of wew not fully primitive-closed.
Table 4 complete root-vector Clifford representatives and independent all generator commutators still not reconstructed; one phiZero sample only.
Coupling normalization g1 and Weinberg angle are source claims only, no independent physical-parameter prediction qualified.
L01 §2.2.3 exact graviweak Cl(7,1) and combination H1 remain pending.
Other L01-L06 source assertion census remains G0 incomplete; G1-G7 current replay forbidden.

expected_limited_finite_reconstruction.positive_metric_control: six derived common/difference bivectors from original gammaPrime are block diagonal with i sigma upper/lower actions
negative_controls: exchange W and B1 source block roles
reverse U sign only in one chirality
incorrectly replace phiOne with real phi^1
alter one Table 4 halfY or Q cell
replace real W3 with imaginary W3 (out of source su2 domain)
